toolTypeCorrections.reason: It validates caption timing against rules; validation is the core function, not generation.
Core function is audio signal analysis (beat detection), not content generation.
Core function is analyzing an audio file to find silence regions.
Core function is measuring audio levels (dBFS), i.e. signal measurement.

edgeCases: source footage lower res than recommended export -> warn against upscaling; frame rate mismatch -> advise matching source or integer multiple; unknown platform -> fall back to safe H.264/1080p/30 defaults with warning
tools.feasibilityNote: Pure rule table lookup over data/platform-rules/capcut.json. Zero compute risk.
tools.name: CapCut Export Settings Finder
validation: platform must be a known enum value
priority must be one of the three allowed

edgeCases: empty script -> error; extremely long script -> cap scroll plan and warn; wpm outside range -> clamp with warning; CJK text (chars != words) -> use chars-per-minute mode with note

tools.name: Teleprompter

edgeCases: word already phonetic -> return unchanged with note; proper nouns -> suggest syllable-split spelling; non-Latin script -> mark unsupported with explanation

edgeCases: already-clean text -> return unchanged, zero changes; ALL-CAPS shouting preserved intentionally -> option to keep; mixed languages -> only apply rules to Latin-script segments, leave others untouched
tools.feasibilityNote: Pure regex/string rules. No model needed; must never claim AI understanding.
tools.name: Auto-Caption Cleanup Tool

edgeCases: single word longer than maxChars -> hard break with warning; CJK text -> use 16 chars/line default per Netflix CJK guidance; text already within limits -> return as-is
tools.feasibilityNote: Pure greedy/DP line-breaking with linguistic break preferences (break after punctuation, before conjunctions/prepositions per Netflix style guidance).
tools.name: Subtitle Line Breaker

edgeCases: empty input -> error, no output; CRLF line endings -> normalized; dot decimals accepted with warning; missing sequence numbers -> renumber with warning; end<=start -> error on that cue; overlapping cues -> warning; non-sequential numbering -> warning; unicode preserved byte-identical
tools.feasibilityNote: Fully pure. Reference implementation shipped at app/tools/video-editing/srt-to-vtt-converter/logic.ts with node:test suite.
tools.name: SRT to VTT Converter
validation: input is a string; blocks split on blank lines; each block has sequence number, HH:MM:SS,mmm --> HH:MM:SS,mmm timing line, and >=1 text line

edgeCases: zero-duration cue -> error; gap < 83ms between cues -> warning (Netflix 2-frame rule); duration > 7000ms -> warning; duration < 833ms -> warning (flash risk); single cue file -> skip gap checks
tools.feasibilityNote: Pure rule engine over cue list. Thresholds from Netflix Timed Text Style Guide (verified 2026-10-01).
inputs: cues[] {startMs, endMs, text} or pasted SRT/VTT
tools.name: Caption Timing Validator

edgeCases: CJK text -> apply 9 CPS (Simplified Chinese) threshold, never Latin 20; children -> 17 CPS cap; exactly at threshold -> pass with note; empty text cue -> error
tools.feasibilityNote: CPS = chars / seconds is pure math; thresholds are verified published standards (Netflix 20 adult / 17 children; BBC 160-180 wpm ≈ 14-16 CPS). Social short-form has no official CPS standard — any short-form preset must be labeled guidance, not standard.
tools.name: Caption Readability (CPS) Checker
validation: text counted with spaces+punctuation per Netflix counting rule

edgeCases: more lines than fit at min 833ms each -> error suggesting fewer lines; uneven line lengths -> distribute by character weight, not equal split; bpm given -> snap boundaries to beats
tools.feasibilityNote: Pure proportional allocation math. Word-level timings are estimates — UI must label them as starting points for manual sync, not measured timings.
tools.name: Karaoke Timing Grid Planner

edgeCases: very long names -> auto-shrink font with note; duration < min read time for text length -> warn (uses CPS check); empty title allowed (name-only style)
tools.feasibilityNote: Pure template string generation + CSS. No rendering needed client-side beyond preview (MA1 UI).
tools.name: Lower Third Generator

edgeCases: duration too short for effect readability -> warn; karaoke-highlight needs per-word timing -> falls back to even split with warning
tools.feasibilityNote: Generates CSS keyframes + step-by-step CapCut instructions. CapCut has no keyframe-CSS import, so the CapCut path is human instructions, not a file — UI must be honest about that.
tools.name: Text Animation Preset Generator

edgeCases: unknown vibe -> default to bold with note; preset uses font not on user device -> list fallback fonts
tools.feasibilityNote: Static curated content bank, not computation. Value is curation; verify no trademarked font names are misrepresented. 'Generator' kept as closest valid type (produces a preset config).
tools.name: Caption Style Preset Library
outputs: preset {font, size, stroke, shadow, bg, animation, colors}

edgeCases: bezier x outside 0-1 -> error (invalid CSS); overshoot y -> warn (anticipation effect); CapCut has limited easing options -> map to nearest available with note

tools.name: Keyframe Easing Visualizer
validation: custom bezier control points within 0-1 for x (y may overshoot)

edgeCases: image smaller than output frame at max zoom -> error (would upscale); zoomStrength 1.0 -> degenerate to static, warn; extreme pan on narrow image -> clamp and warn

tools.name: Ken Burns Path Planner

edgeCases: transitions eat whole duration -> error; single slide -> transition skipped with note; weightedByText needs per-slide text lengths

tools.name: Slideshow Timing Planner

edgeCases: subject contains green (plants, uniforms) -> recommend blue screen with explanation; sampleHex near gray -> warn keying will be hard
tools.feasibilityNote: Pure color math (RGB->HSV, hue distance). Does NOT do actual chroma keying — that needs pixel access; tool only recommends the key color and tolerance range. UI must say so.
tools.name: Green Screen Color Picker
validation: at least 1 subject color in suggest mode

edgeCases: sourceFps not a multiple of timelineFps -> judder warning; desired slow factor needs higher fps than source -> recommend reshoot fps; 240fps+ sources -> note light flicker risk

tools.name: Slow-Mo Frame Rate Planner

edgeCases: bpm 0/negative -> error; very high bpm (>200) -> warn cuts may feel frantic; intro offset beyond duration -> error
tools.feasibilityNote: Pure math: beat interval = 60000/BPM. Cut points are arithmetic markers, not detected beats.
tools.name: BPM Beat-Match Planner

edgeCases: silent file -> zero peaks, explicit message; variable-tempo music -> warn markers are onset-based, not true beats; decode failure -> error naming the likely cause
tools.feasibilityNote: FEASIBILITY FLAG: real onset detection needs the Web Audio API to decode the user's uploaded file and an energy-flux algorithm — doable fully client-side, but the pure-logic layer can only implement the peak-picking math on a provided amplitude array. Logic stays pure (operates on Float32Array peaks); file decode + rendering is the app shell's job (MA1). No server, no API.
tools.name: Audio Waveform Beat Marker
validation: size cap e.g. 100MB with error beyond

edgeCases: no gaps found -> explicit 'none found, try lower threshold'; whole file silent -> single gap with warning; noisy room tone -> warn threshold may need raising
tools.feasibilityNote: FEASIBILITY FLAG: same as 269 — needs user-uploaded audio decoded via Web Audio API in-browser. Pure logic operates on RMS/dB arrays only. Fully client-side, zero API, but not pure-logic-alone.
tools.name: Silence Gap Finder

edgeCases: clipping (samples at 0dBFS) -> error-level warning; all silence -> explicit message; mic permission denied -> UI-level error, logic untouched
tools.feasibilityNote: FEASIBILITY FLAG: dB math (F-DB-01) is pure; getting samples needs Web Audio API (file decode or getUserMedia). Logic layer takes a Float32Array and returns measurements. Real-time metering loop is app-shell/UI work.
tools.name: Voiceover Level Meter

edgeCases: timestamp beyond duration -> clamp to last frame with warning; DRM/protected stream -> cannot process, error; very large video -> warn about memory
tools.feasibilityNote: FEASIBILITY FLAG: needs browser <video> + canvas to seek and draw the frame — fully client-side, but impossible in pure logic. Logic layer's job: timestamp clamping/validation math and dimension scaling math only. No upload to any server.
tools.name: Video Frame Grabber
validation: file is a playable video mime

edgeCases: target wider than source -> letterbox instead of crop, explain; 9:16 from 16:9 loses ~44% width -> warn; custom anchor outside bounds -> clamp with warning
